records.body:
Dear Nadia, 

As per the order of the Hon. Mr. Justice MacDonal's order dated November 17, 2022, paragraph 12.g, we are required not to dispose, deal with, or diminish the value of the bank accounts mentioned in paragraph 11.a-c. This is in effect until the financial remedy application is concluded, a further court order is issued, or both parties' solicitors agree otherwise in writing.  We are allowed to use these funds for specific payments, with the remaining balance to be shared equally between us.

In compliance with the above, I have transferred $14,850 from the Metropolitan Commercial Bank of New York to your Wells Fargo account and have transferred the same amount to my Citibank account. This is the only way for me to to meet my MPS obligation and I will be doing the same thing on 1 March 2024 to meet the March MPS payment order.

Kind regards

Karim


Begin forwarded message:

From: Karim Zahmoul <karim@zahmoul.net>
Subject: Current state of Assets and payment of US$ 50,000 from Metropolitan Commercial Bank of NY
Date: May 2, 2023 at 21:59:40 GMT+1
To: "Nadia.Zahmoul" <nadia.zahmoul@protonmail.com>

Dear Nadia,

As per the order of the Hon. Mr. Justice MacDonal's order dated November 17, 2022, paragraph 12.g, we are required not to dispose, deal with, or diminish the value of the bank accounts mentioned in paragraph 11.a-c. This is in effect until the financial remedy application is concluded, a further court order is issued, or both parties' solicitors agree otherwise in writing. We are allowed to use these funds for specific payments, with the remaining balance to be shared equally between us.

In compliance with the above, I have transferred $50,000 from the Metropolitan Commercial Bank of New York to your Wells Fargo account. This is half of the $100,000 we can distribute after setting aside $20,000 for managing the New York properties. This amount should also cover the costs of the weekly transfers I make to you until September 20, 2023. Unfortunately, you have prevented Outpost from doing the same and preferred to send the $20,000 to a blocked account rather than follow the order's provisions.

Enclosed is an updated statement of assets, including updated bank account information, which I will also submit to the court. Our current liquidity is low, considering our liabilities, and we may need to use my life insurance policy soon if we don't address the situation constructively.

Our significant liabilities include:
$1,450,000 due by September 20, 2025 (approx. $50,000 per month for 27 months remaining) (GBP 1,160,000)
Potential Portugal CGT on Coinbase sale before 2026: €382,000 (agreed to keep in escrow with Nicholas Warr) (GBP340,000)
Girls' education through 2029: $880,000 (GBP 700,000)
Jade Mia University tuition and living expenses  for 2023-2026: $480,000
Lila Mae University tuition and living expenses for 2026-2029: $480,000
Potential tax on 16.6 BTC sold in Xapo if I become a US resident in 2023: $105,000 (GBP 84,000)
Total actual and potential liabilities: $2,850,000 (GBP 2,284,000)
Your annual expenses for the remainder of 2023: £123,000 - £40,000 = £83,000 My expenses for the remainder of 2023: £83,000 NZ and KZ expenses until the year-end 2023: £166,000

Our current liquid asset are c. GBP 700,000 and our joint current burn rate is about GBP1,000 per day excluding the above joint liabilities. This excludes Jade Mia and Lila Mae. They will each require a budget of $120,000 per annum, Jade starting in July 2023 and Lila Mae in July of 2025. That is another GBP 265 per Day per girl to be able to afford they education from our joint assets. 

I am happy to discuss providing Lila Mae some pocket money out of the matrimonial asset for her personal travel during school breaks and exeats to include (airfare, exchange programmes if she want, per dium, etc ) until she joins Jade Mia at University in the United States.

Annual NZ & KZ: GBP 365,000 - Monthly NZ & KZ: GBP 30,400 - Daily NZ & KZ: GBP 1,000

Annual JMZ & LMZ: GBP 192,000, Monthly JMZ & LMZ: 16,000 - Daily JMZ & LMZ: GBP 530

Our properties revenues are crucial for meeting these liabilities to avoid being ordered to sell properties or being foreclosed on them. I urge you once again to minimize your time using them while in WY, as it increases our tax liabilities, reduces deductions, and will force us to start dipping into my life insurance and or pension funds, which should be avoided as we are too young to be doing that.

I would like to take this opportunity to share my perspective on splitting the income, while acknowledging that the judge's LSPO and final judgement will ultimately determine the outcome. It is my belief that an equal split of assets is the right financial outcome for both of us. I want to reassure you that there are no undisclosed assets, and while you are welcome to investigate further, I encourage you to consider the possibility that no hidden assets exist.

In terms of litigation expenses, it seems reasonable for each of us to be responsible for our own costs, including any litigation loans. Regarding the Cheltenham rental, I am willing to pay the remainder of the stay through July and, if you choose to cancel the WY rental, pay for the rental for post-Cheltenham accommodations capped at GBP5,500 per month for the remaining months' rent up until the date of the final judgement. This could help increase the net income for the marital pot while also addressing your concerns about liquidity. If you decide not to cancel the WY rental, I believe you should compensate me for my half of the lost income caused by your occupation of the WY property and you should be responsible for any adverse tax consequences.

Your post-judgement rental expenses in London or elsewhere should be your responsibility, using your share of the post-split income and assets. I will be responsible for my own accommodations. For the children's college education, both of us should contribute equally using our respective post-split income and assets. I still believe that we should set aside about $600K from the marital pot assets for our Jade Mia and Lila Mae's US college expenses. 

I hope this clarifies our current financial situation and encourages a transparent approach to equally using our funds.

Thanks

Karim

records.subject: Confidential - Ongoing criminal investigation IRS: CI - Cyber Investigation Unit - New York Field Office - Part 1 of 4
records.body:
Zahmoul v. Zahmoul  - BV20D01752 

  

Dear Marlon,

 

I am sorry to hear you had Covid and I hope you are making a full recovery.

 

Please see below the email exchange with M. Robert McGarry, Special Agent, U.S. Department of the Treasury, IRS:CI / Cyber Investigations Unit, New York Field Office.  I have been informed that Special Agent McGarry has an ongoing criminal investigation into Mr. Zahmoul’s money laundering of proceeds from prostitution services using cryptocurrency.

Please feel free to contact Special Agent McGarry directly to confirm the facts I am referencing. 

Taking into consideration your background as a criminal investigator, and in accordance with my duty to act with honesty and integrity vis-à-vis you, the SJE, I am hereby confidentially notifying you that there is an ongoing investigation by the United States Internal Revenue Service - Criminal Investigations Division - Cyber Investigations Unit,  New York Field Office into the source of the criminal property into BTC cluster 1AWKgdMEwDjHxL3WcaoijvmnH5LXkTA3zw  (known as the “Molina Cluster”) which, upon information and belief, was managed by Mr. Karim Noureddine Zahmoul (“Mr. Zahmoul”) in furtherance of the prostitution activities led and coordinated by Ms. Olivia Molina Avellaneda (“Ms. Molina”) in Dubai and elsewhere under Blue Ocean Services FZE (“Blue Ocean.”)

The evidence supports the fact that Mr. Zahmoul, along with others, was not only instrumental in setting up the front company through which Ms. Molina operated but also in placing, layering, and integrating the proceeds of her illicit activities and laundering those proceeds across international borders.  I became aware of Mr. Zahmoul’s participation in laundering criminal proceeds for Ms. Molina during the pandemic when he shared with me and with our daughters that he was laundering money for Ms. Molina through his American Express card because of their origin. However, at the time, I did not understand the magnitude of Mr. Zahmoul’s involvement in money laundering of prostitution proceeds using cryptocurrency. Furthermore, I did not understand the implications his illicit activities could have for the financial remedy settlement which will be decided at the Final Hearing in High Court, Family Division set to begin on 19 February 2024.

My U.S. attorney has advised me about the potential risk for criminal asset forfeiture I am exposed to in relation to the tainted criminal property laundered by Mr. Zahmoul through the Molina Cluster, sent into the Coinbase account which formed part of our marital assets and ultimately comingled with our marital assets.  These laundered funds were then unilaterally used by Mr. Zahmoul to pay down the joint mortgage we held at Bank of Jackson Hole against the properties at 3093 and 3100 Arrowhead Road (known as the “Wyoming properties.”) 

Given Mr. Zahmoul’s dissipation of the marital balance sheet, the Wyoming properties represent a significant part of our remaining assets.  More importantly, the house at 3093 Arrowhead Road is considered “home” by our daughters after our forced displacement from the UK.  I have further been advised - and it has become evident to me - that a potential criminal asset forfeiture action would directly reduce my financial award and compromise my daughters’ future and my own.

This email and the attachments are consistent with the (i) Family Court’s Practice Direction 25-D “Financial Remedy Proceedings & the Use of Subject Joint Experts” which sets out the fact that the overriding objective of the selection and appointment of a Single Joint Expert is to enable the court to deal with cases justly, and (ii) my acknowledgement and understanding that Another Day investigators, acting in the interests of justice, must investigate all reasonable lines of inquiry, as referenced in the Master Services Agreement signed and entered in to by all parties.

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

Dear Tim,

 

Please see below, Special Agent McGarry states that it is against IRS CI policy to make a statement regarding an ongoing investigation.

 

I will continue to upload to the IRS CI shared drive all relevant information in support of their investigation into Mr. Zahmoul’s money laundering of prostitution proceeds using cryptocurrency, placing, layering, and integrating in the UK banking system and in the US via wire transfers, American Express, and comingling of funds used to pay our mortgage at Bank of Jackson Hole in Wyoming. This also includes all the information he filed during the course of these proceedings and all the reports you write.

 

Our “visible” assets are all US-situs, none is in the UK. I am at risk of asset forfeiture, and this is a risk which the Court must be informed of in order to make a judgement and settlement which is just and fair.

 

There is a huge amount of undisclosed cryptocurrency assets, the information is the electronic devices held in escrow by HFC by order of the Court. I will file an affidavit on Friday requesting that you examine the electronic devices. The Ubuntu computer runs a Bitcoin Core node, has wallets, and ViaBtC mining. I attach a review by Paul Sibenik of hard copies of information from the Ubuntu computers which are not confidential. These devices must be reviewed by you because they evidence undisclosed assets. The second device in escrow is a MacPro computer and contains evidence of the respondent’s criminal activities and his role in organizing, facilitating, and implementing money laundering of proceeds from prostitution. 

 

The respondent is falsely incriminating Miss Molina, and she is unaware that he has attributed to her the ownership and control of the money laundering/prostitution cluster 1AWKg. Miss Molina is innocent of the crimes the respondent is implicating her in, and the IRS CI is aware of that. I am innocent and my daughters are innocent. We must be protected of the risk of asset forfeiture.

 

My overriding objective is to protect my daughters, one of them has autism and lifelong special needs.

 

I hope you will do your duty as Minister of Justice and your duty to the Court which appointed you as expert in order to support the judge make a division of assets which considers all aspects of the case.

 

Your duty is not to the respondent and is not to me. Your duty is to serve the Court and Justice. My duty is to my daughters who are innocent and voiceless.

 

If you don’t bring thing matter to Justice, who will?

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

Dear Brent,

 

THE FOLLOWING SHOWS THAT ONCE AGAIN, THE RESPONDENT IS TAKING ME AND THE COURT FOR FOOLS. Please send to the judge

 

The Oxus and Borealis M&A closed on 7 February 2024 and the Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8 February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRSL.

 
The attached forms from the SEC provide documentary evidence of the following facts:
 
The respondent has 50,000 Founder shares
The grant value is $0.33 per share
The shares are now listed on Nasdaq under ticker symbol BRLS
The current market price is $9.20
The current price appreciation (book value): 2588%
The current market value of the respondent’s shares: $443,500
Lock-up period: one year 
 
Warrants and Options granted to directors and founders have not been disclosed.
 

 
The Final Hearing before Justice MacDonald started on Monday 19th February. During his testimonies under oath the respondent represented that his shares in Oxus Acquisition Fund were worth zero. He also instructed his counsel to represent to the Court that his “shares in Oxus were on the side and were worth zero”. This is a false representation. The shares owned by the respondent are worth $443,500. The lock-up period does define the value of the shares. The respondent can borrow against the shares during the lock-up and can monetize them. He knows this. The key metric which determines the value of the shares is the CLOSING OF THE MERGER TRANSACTION. This happened on 7 February 2024, 11 days before the trial started. 
THAT IS THE DATE WHICH DETERMINES THE VALUE OF THE RESPONDENT’S SHARES.

 

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

records.subject: Imerman - legal options
records.body:
Dear Zoe and Brent,

 

Thank you for your time yesterday and for your advice with regards to the Oxus/Borealis merger and Newco’s debut on Nasdaq on 8 February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.

 

With regards to Imerman, I am not satisfied with doing nothing because not only it is a hugely unfair and inequitable outcome, but also the devices contain forensic evidence of criminal activities which represent a direct financial risk to me in the future and therefore should, at a minimum, be preserved in escrow. Please see the attached correspondence clip and the summary document titled “Imerman".
The respondent asked me to pause the Imerman process in order to save costs and reach a settlement via mediation. In her letter to HFC dated 20 May 2021 (page 10), Diana Parker was extremely clear that the process would resume should we fail to reach a settlement. Since the FDR in July 2021 the respondent has systematically opposed all my attempts to resume the Imerman process. 
On 20th November 2023, Zoe wrote to the respondent’s solicitors in order to resume the Imerman process.
Their reply of 21 November 2023 is attached. 
The Imerman review is my right and the respondent’s duty. The guidance in UL v BK reads: “The husband's solicitor, who owes a high duty to the court, will read [the Imerman documents] and disclose those of them that are both admissible and relevant to the wife's claim, pursuant to the husband's duty of full and frank disclosure”.
Given the non-disclosures in this case, the importance of crypto assets, and the respondent’s litigation conduct, it is extremely unfair that I am being denied my rights for an equitable and just process. 
I was not able to undertake the Imerman process because the respondent used his unlimited resources to oppose it, while he starved me of liquidity.
The respondent’s efforts to obstruct due process of justice should be considered and the harm he has caused me should not be compounded by the very institution which is supposed to grant fairness and equity.
 

Further considerations:
The respondent’s review of the hard copy Imerman documents was woefully dishonest and misleading.
As with everything else in these proceedings, I only found out three years later when my brother explained to me what a node was.
Paul Sibenik’s review of the Imerman hard copy documents is attached. 
Sibenik’s review demonstrates that the respondent’s narrative of 24 June 2021 is completely false. 
Sibenik’s review supports the claim that the respondent’s crypto activities are institutional.
 

The other important consideration is that the MacBook Pro computer held in escrow contains forensic evidence of the respondent’s activities related to money laundering of prostitution proceeds. I mentioned this in my conduct statement as well as my section 25. Given the ongoing criminal investigation and the potential risk of asset forfeiture, the devices should not be returned to the respondent.

 

Please consider the attached documents and let me know what my legal options are.

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

Dear Zoe,

 

Yesterday you mentioned that there were no funds on the account, and this would have an impact on the work that must be done to prepare for the settlement and the orders. 

 

This is not an area I am willing to take any chances in and I would like the execution to be flawless, and the work detailed, diligent and error-free. 

 

This is the culmination of four years of work and brutal war, and any mistakes at this stage can have lifelong consequences for the children and me. I will not be experimenting. 

 

Also, I have to be extremely vigilant with the orders because this is an area where KZ has consistently manipulated the system and inserted paragraphs, sentences, and wording that had a permanent negative impact on my position.

 

As such, I would be grateful if you could please let me know what to expect from today onwards and until the process is completely finalized and the money in the bank. I would like a clear and detailed road map of the tasks we must complete, the ones I have to prepare by myself, and the level of support and guidance you can give me (if any). records.body:
Dear Brent and Zoe,

 

I hope you are well.

 

GENERAL – PROCESS GOING FORWARD:

 

This is my second email regarding Oxus and the respondent’s false representations to the court during the Final Trial.

This is my third email requesting clarity on the process going forward.

 

Zoe emailed today: “As Brent advised on Thursday, we should first ascertain Karim’s position in relation to Oxus before considering any next steps”. 

This is not a satisfactory answer because time is not neutral. The passage of time is positive for the respondent and negative for me. I need something better, more precise, and I need an explanation.

 

Basic game theory states that the respondent’s best alternative is to not answer our request and to delay as much as possible. This is what he has done with every single issue that what NOT in his best interest, including: Imerman, NY appraisals, Coinbase, Forte Securities. This is what he is doing now.

 

Basic game theory states that the sooner I send this to the judge, the more impact it will have on his judgement.

 

I am not willing to wait indefinitely for the respondent to provide an answer which we all know he will need a gun to his head to produce as it is hugely negative to his case.

 

In the absence of any guidelines from you and Zoe regarding how long you are asking me to wait for an answer which I know will not be forthcoming, and in the absence of any communications from you and Zoe since 29 February 2024,  I am utterly without guidance and advice at a stage which is critical for the rest of my life and my daughters’ financial future. 

 

Thus, unless you and Zoe communicate with me and explain what the process is from now to the end, and what the deadline for the respondent to respondent to Oxus and what are the supporting arguments behind your proposed deadline, I have decided to send the Oxus matter to His Lordship tomorrow by noon because I have no way of knowing what is best for me given the absence of communication from counsel and from my solicitor. 

 
I have been extremely clear that I will not take any chances with the process from now until the time the money is in the bank.
I have explained that I would like COMPLETE CLARITY AS TO WHAT LEVEL OF SUPPORT AND ADVICE AND GUIDANCE I CAN EXPECT FROM YOU. 
I HAVE EXPLAINED THAT I AM NOT IN A RISK-TAKING MODE AND I WANT AN ERROR-FREE EXECUTION PROCESS FROM NOW UNTIL THE TIME THE MONEY IS IN THE BANK, AND MUST BE EXTREMELY VIGILENT WITH THE COURT ORDERS.
I HAVE EXPLAINED THAT I COMPLETELY UNDERSTAND IF YOU AND ZOE ARE NOT FUNDED TO PROVIDE THE LEVEL OF HAND HOLDING, I AM REQUESTING BUT I WOULE LIKE YOU TO TELL ME NOW. NOT TOMORROW. BUT NOW.
THEN, I WILL BE FREE TO EXPLORE OPTIONS THAT WORK FOR ME.  THE PROCESS AHEAD OF US HAS HUGE EXECUTION RISKS AND I NEED HAND HOLDING, COMMUNICATION, EXPERT ADVICE, AND EXTREME VIGILENCE. 
IF YOU CANNOT PROVIDE WHAT I NEED, YOU MUST TELL ME KNOW SO I CAN DO WHAT IS BEST FOR ME AND MY DAUGHTERS.
I CANNOT STAY IN THE DARK ABOUT THE FORTHCOMING PROCESS. THIS IS NOT AN OPTION. EVERY DAY AND EVERY MINUTE COUNTS. I NEED OPEN CHANNELS OF COMMUNICATION; I NEED TO UNDERSTAND THE PROCESS. 
I NEED TO HAVE EXTREMELY CLEAR AND REALISTIC EXPECTATIONS. PLEASE SET OUT WHAT SCAFFOLDING (IN ANY) YOU CAN PROVIDE ME UNTIL THE END OF THE PROCESS.
IF IT IS NOT SUFFICIENT FOR ME, THEN IT IS MY JOB TO FIND A SET UP THAT WORKS FOR ME.
FOR NOW, YOU ARE HOLDING ME BACK BECAUSE YOU SAID YOU ARE NOT IN FUNDS AND NOW YOU ARE NOT TELLING ME WHAT THAT MEANS IN TERMS OF MY CASE.
I SAID VERY CLEARLY WHAT MY NEEDS AND EXPECTATIONS ARE.
I UNDERSTAND YOU ARE NOT IN FUNDS AND I RESPECT YOU RUN A BUSINESS, NOT A CHARITABLE ORGANISATION.
PLEASE EXPLAIN TO ME VERY CLEARLY WHAT YOU CAN DELIVER (IF ANY) AND WHAT YOU CANNOT.
STAYING IN THE DARK IS NOT AN OPTION. I NEED TO DECIDE AND MOVE FORWARD. MY LIFE AND MY CHILDREN’S FREEDOM DEPENDS ON WHAT I DO IN THE NEXT FEW WEEKS.
I CANNOT AFFORD ANY UNCERTAINTY AND I NEED EXACTLY WHAT I SPELT OUT ABOVE: HAND-HOLDING AT EVERY STEP, EXTREME VIGILENCE WITH THE COURT ORDERS, SEEMLESS COMMUNICATION BETWEEN ME, YOU AND BRENT, UNTIL THE MONEY IS IN THE BANK AND MY FUTURE LITIGATIONS AGAINST THE RESPONDENDENT ARE SECURE AND UNOPPOSED BY THIS COURT.
IF THIS IS NOT POSSIBLE, TELL ME IMMEDIATELY, IN WRITING, SO I AM FREE TO CONSIDER THE OPTIONS THAT SUIT MY NEEDS AS DEFINED BY ME.
 

OXUS: GRANT DATE (CONDITIONAL) VS TRIGGER DATE VS VESTING DATE

 

I am presenting the key points supporting my position that the respondent lied under oath and made flagrant false representation, that the respondent knew and should have known that his 50,000 shares were NOT worth zero at the time of the Final Trial, and that he intentionally made representations he knew to be false and took the Court and me for fools in order to keep the windfall for himself.

 

I am adding the vesting schedule so you can understand the full picture.

 

Further to my email of 29 February 2024 setting out the timeline of the closing of the transaction and the consummation of the acquisition by Oxus of Borealis (the Target), the business combination closed on 7th February 2024 and, on 8th February 2024, Newco began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol BRLS.

 

As per the attached SEC filings and as discussed at our meeting on 29 February 2024, here is a recap of the events:

 
The respondent was granted 50,000 Founders’ shares on 7 June 2022 (page 341 of attached SEC Prospectus)
The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination).
The Business Combination occurred on 7th February 2024.
Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8th February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.
The Founder Shares lock-up period is defined below and in page 5 of the Prospectus filed with the SEC (attached).
 

 

FALSE REPRESENTATIONS TO HIS LORDSHIP UNDER OATH: THERE ARE THREE DATES WHICH FAMILY COURT MUST UNDERSTAND: (I) GRANT DATE, (II) EFFECTIVE DATE, AND (III) VESTING DATE. 

 
STEP 1: GRANT DATE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT OWNERSHIP OF 50,000 CONDITIONAL TO BUSINESS COMBINATION.
STEP 2: EFFECTIVE DATE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT UNCONDITIONAL OWNERSHIP OF 50,000 SHARES UPON CLOSING OF THE BUSINESS COMBINATION.
STEP 3: VESTING SCHEDULE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT THE RIGHT TO SELL HIS SHARES ACCORDING TO A TWO-TIER SCHEDULE.
 

THE RESPONDENT HAS MADE AN INTENTIONAL WORLD SALAD OF THE ABOVE AND IS ONCE AGAIN LEVERAGING HIS ASYMETRICAL KNOWLEDGE OF FINANCE IN ORDER TO CREATE CONFUSION BETWEEN THE THREE DATES (I) THE GRANT DATE (7 JUNE 2022), (II) THE EFFECTIVE DATE (COMPLETION OF BUSINESS COMBINATION 7TH FEBRUARY 2024) AND (III) VESTING DATE (50% FORMULA AND 50% 12 MONTHS AFTER BUSINESS COMBINATION).

 

TESTIMONY UNDER OATH AT THE FINAL TRIAL

 

ON 19TH FEBRUARY 2024, THE FINAL TRIAL “ZAHMOUL VS ZAHMOUL” BEGAN IN THE RCJ, HIGH COURT FAMILY DIVISION, BEFORE HIS LORDSHIP JUSTICE MACDONALD.

 

THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT MADE DURING THE TRIAL UNDER OATH:  “THE FOUNDERS’ SHARES HELD BY THE RESPONDENT ARE WORTH ZERO” IS A FALSE STATEMENT AND LIE MADE TO THE COURT UNDER OATH.

 

THE RESPONDENT FALSELY REPRESENTED TO THE COURT UNDER OATH THAT HIS 50,000 SHARES WERE WORTH “ZERO” AND THAT HE WOULD NOT KNOW THEIR VALUE UNTIL ONE YEAR HAS PASSED. THIS IS AN INTENTIOANL MISREPRESENTATION AND IT IS A FALSE STATEMENT. THE VALUE OF THE RESPONDENT’S HOLDINGS CAN NOW BE TRACKED DAILY ON A MARKED-TO-MARKET BASIS USING BRLS PRICE PERFORMANCE. THE RESPONDENT CAN MONETIZE THIS POSITION, BORROW AGAINST IT, pleadge it, use it as collateral, USE IT IN HIS ASSET SCHEDULE WHEN APPLYING TO MORTGAGE INSTITUTIONS, ETC. IT IS PART OF HIS ASSETS AND IT HAS A VALUE OF APPROXIMATELY $0.5 MILLION. VESTING PERIOD HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH OWNERSHIP OF THE ASSET. THE ASSET HAS A VALUE AND THE ASSET CAN NOW BE INCLUDED IN THE RESPONDENT’S PERSONAL BALANCE SHEET.

 

MORE IMPORTANTLY, AS OF 7 FEBRUARY 2024, THE RESPONDENT HAD A DUTY TO UPDATE HIS FORM E AND REPORT HIS 50,000 FOUNDERS SHARES IN OXUS AT THE VALUE OF $0.5 MILLION.

 

AT THE TIME HE MADE THIS STATEMENT AND HE INSTRUCTED HIS COUNSEL TO SAY THE SAME, THIS WAS A FALSE REPRESENTATION AND THE RESPONDENT KNEW IT TO BE A FALSE REPRESENTATION.

 

THERE IS NO STRESS, NO INNUENDOS, NO EXCUSES, NO KITE SURFING: THIS IS A PREMEDITATED, CALCULATED, AND INTENTIONAL FALSE REPRESENTATION WITH THE INTENT TO MAKE A FINANCIAL GAIN AT MY EXPENSE. 

 

THE RESPONDENT IS TAKING THE COURT AND ME FOR FOOLS.

 

Page 5 of Prospectus: Vesting period.

Founder Shares are subject to lock-up until (i) with respect to 50% of the Founder Shares, the earlier of one year after the date of the consummation of the initial Business Combination and the date on which the closing price of the Class A ordinary shares equals or exceeds $12.00 per share (as adjusted for share splits, share dividends, reorganizations and recapitalizations) for any 20 trading days within a 30-trading day period commencing after the consummation of the initial Business Combination and (ii) with respect to the remaining 50% of the Founder Shares, the one-year anniversary of the consummation of the initial Business Combination. 

 

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

Dear Brent,

 

THE FOLLOWING SHOWS THAT ONCE AGAIN, THE RESPONDENT IS TAKING ME AND THE COURT FOR FOOLS. Please send to the judge

 

The Oxus and Borealis M&A closed on 7 February 2024 and the Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8 February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRSL.

 
The attached forms from the SEC provide documentary evidence of the following facts:
 
The respondent has 50,000 Founder shares
The grant value is $0.33 per share
The shares are now listed on Nasdaq under ticker symbol BRLS
The current market price is $9.20
The current price appreciation (book value): 2588%
The current market value of the respondent’s shares: $443,500
Lock-up period: one year 
 
Warrants and Options granted to directors and founders have not been disclosed.
 

 
The Final Hearing before Justice MacDonald started on Monday 19th February. During his testimonies under oath the respondent represented that his shares in Oxus Acquisition Fund were worth zero. He also instructed his counsel to represent to the Court that his “shares in Oxus were on the side and were worth zero”. This is a false representation. The shares owned by the respondent are worth $443,500. The lock-up period does define the value of the shares. The respondent can borrow against the shares during the lock-up and can monetize them. He knows this. The key metric which determines the value of the shares is the CLOSING OF THE MERGER TRANSACTION. This happened on 7 February 2024, 11 days before the trial started. 
THAT IS THE DATE WHICH DETERMINES THE VALUE OF THE RESPONDENT’S SHARES.

 

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

Dear Anita,

 

I hope you are well.

I would be most grateful if you could please pass this on to His Lordship. 

This is material to the case and to the Final Hearing which took place before His Lordship on 19th - 28th February 2024. 

I am copying counsels on both sides.

Thank you very much.

 

With my kind wishes,

Nadia

 

 

Your Lordship,

 

I am sincerely sorry to trouble Your Lordship so soon after the Final Hearing. The matter of Oxus Acquisition Corp. is very material to the case and came to my attention almost immediately after the trial ended.  Despite writing to the respondent one week ago to request an explanation, we have not received a reply. 

 

This open-ended situation is very harmful to me. I feel powerless, vulnerable, and extremely distressed. I find it impossible to put the children’s and my future into the respondent’s hands and wait without knowing how long I must wait.

 

I put the matter into Your Lordship’s hands and if one week is not enough, I am happy to wait as long as Your Lordship would like me to. 

 

At the Final Hearing and under oath, the respondent represented that his shares in Oxus Acquisition Corp. were “worth zero”. In the asset schedule submitted for the Final Hearing, he reported 50,000 shares at a value of $0.00. 

 

This is factually incorrect and constitutes a false statement.

 
The respondent was appointed to the Board of Directors of Oxus Acquisition Corp. on 1st June 2022 and 
On 7th June 2022 Form 3 “Initial Statement of Beneficial Ownership of Securities” was filed with the SEC.
PAGE 340 of SEC PROSPECTUS (attached): “On June 7, 2022, 50,000 Founder Shares were transferred to Mr. Karim Zahmoul by the Sponsor. The fair value of the 50,000 Founder Shares granted to the Mr. Karim Zahmoul on June 7, 2022, was $0.02 million or $0.33 per share. The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination)”.
The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination).
The Business Combination occurred on 7th February 2024.
Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8th February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.
The Founder Shares lock-up period is defined in page 43 of the Prospectus filed with the SEC (attached) and in the attached SEC Filings Excerpts.
 

Conclusion: 

The Final Hearing started on 19th February 2024. 

At the time of the Final Hearing and when he testified under oath, the respondent knew (i) that the Business Combination had occurred and (ii) that the value of his 50,000 Founders Shares was not zero.

Email sent to the respondent’s solicitors on 29th February 2024 (attached):

“Dear Valeria,

We attach documents in relation to the SPAC merger between Oxus and Borealis which closed on 7th February 2024. The post-merger stock has been trading on the NASDAQ since the 8th February 2024. In his ES2 dated 19.02.2024 he ascribes a nil value to his OXUS equity. Given that the merged entity (ticker BRLS) is trading at a stock price of $9.20 (and your client had 50,000 shares in the pre-merger OXUS) please can you explain the value of his stockholding with reference to the attached documents and any others in your clients possession – and why he ascribed a nil value to his equity in the ES2. 

We look forward to hearing from you.”

 

Respectfully,

 

Nadia Zahmoul

records.summary: On 6 March 2024 at 08:15, Alexis Campbell KC (H's barrister, Joint Head of Chambers at 29BR) emailed Anita Knight (judge's clerk) copying all parties including W directly. The email asked the clerk to pass a message to His Lordship requesting he not read any information sent by W. Campbell KC's message to the judge stated: W had not copied instructing solicitors when submitting her note; Campbell had not had a chance to review the information; she was now engaged on other cases; W's direct contact with third parties "must stop"; and she requested an order that W desist from contacting third parties or sending evidence to the court. Campbell KC also stated the evidence was closed and that if W wished to reopen it she needed to make a formal application. This email was sent at 08:15 — approximately three hours after W's email to the clerk at 05:23, which was itself sent less than 12 hours after W's hospitalisation at Cromwell Hospital. Campbell KC's email makes no reference to W's health situation, funding crisis, or the structural reason why W had contacted the court directly.
records.participation_impact: CRITICAL — W's court access being suppressed by H's senior KC eight hours after W's night email and twelve hours after hospitalisation. Campbell KC's framing ("Mrs Zahmoul has solicitors on the record") ignores that W was effectively without legal support. W's emergency court access treated as misconduct.
records.legal_significance: CRITICAL for all four JR claims: H's KC seeks to suppress W's Oxus evidence; requests order against W's court access; does so without acknowledging W's health crisis or structural cause of direct contact; this is the most significant third-party action in the dataset; absent from judgment
records.action_required: W to respond; court to rule; Oxus submission to be considered on its merits

Dear Anita,

 

I hope you are well.

I would be most grateful if you could please pass this on to His Lordship. 

This is material to the case and to the Final Hearing which took place before His Lordship on 19th - 28th February 2024. 

I am copying counsels on both sides.

Thank you very much.

 

With my kind wishes,

Nadia

 

 

Your Lordship,

 

I am sincerely sorry to trouble Your Lordship so soon after the Final Hearing. The matter of Oxus Acquisition Corp. is very material to the case and came to my attention almost immediately after the trial ended.  Despite writing to the respondent one week ago to request an explanation, we have not received a reply. 

 

This open-ended situation is very harmful to me. I feel powerless, vulnerable, and extremely distressed. I find it impossible to put the children’s and my future into the respondent’s hands and wait without knowing how long I must wait.

 

I put the matter into Your Lordship’s hands and if one week is not enough, I am happy to wait as long as Your Lordship would like me to. 

 

At the Final Hearing and under oath, the respondent represented that his shares in Oxus Acquisition Corp. were “worth zero”. In the asset schedule submitted for the Final Hearing, he reported 50,000 shares at a value of $0.00. 

 

This is factually incorrect and constitutes a false statement.

 
The respondent was appointed to the Board of Directors of Oxus Acquisition Corp. on 1st June 2022 and 
On 7th June 2022 Form 3 “Initial Statement of Beneficial Ownership of Securities” was filed with the SEC.
PAGE 340 of SEC PROSPECTUS (attached): “On June 7, 2022, 50,000 Founder Shares were transferred to Mr. Karim Zahmoul by the Sponsor. The fair value of the 50,000 Founder Shares granted to the Mr. Karim Zahmoul on June 7, 2022, was $0.02 million or $0.33 per share. The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination)”.
The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination).
The Business Combination occurred on 7th February 2024.
Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8th February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.
The Founder Shares lock-up period is defined in page 43 of the Prospectus filed with the SEC (attached) and in the attached SEC Filings Excerpts.
 

Conclusion: 

The Final Hearing started on 19th February 2024. 

At the time of the Final Hearing and when he testified under oath, the respondent knew (i) that the Business Combination had occurred and (ii) that the value of his 50,000 Founders Shares was not zero.

 

Email sent to the respondent’s solicitors on 29th February 2024 (attached):

“Dear Valeria,

We attach documents in relation to the SPAC merger between Oxus and Borealis which closed on 7th February 2024. The post-merger stock has been trading on the NASDAQ since the 8th February 2024. In his ES2 dated 19.02.2024 he ascribes a nil value to his OXUS equity. Given that the merged entity (ticker BRLS) is trading at a stock price of $9.20 (and your client had 50,000 shares in the pre-merger OXUS) please can you explain the value of his stockholding with reference to the attached documents and any others in your clients possession – and why he ascribed a nil value to his equity in the ES2. 

We look forward to hearing from you.”

 

Respectfully,

 

Nadia Zahmoul

 

On 29/02/2024, 3:41 PM, "Nadia" <nadia@rosekross.com> wrote:

 

Dear Brent,

 

THE FOLLOWING SHOWS THAT ONCE AGAIN, THE RESPONDENT IS TAKING ME AND THE COURT FOR FOOLS. Please send to the judge

 

The Oxus and Borealis M&A closed on 7 February 2024 and the Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8 February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRSL.

 
The attached forms from the SEC provide documentary evidence of the following facts:
 
The respondent has 50,000 Founder shares
The grant value is $0.33 per share
The shares are now listed on Nasdaq under ticker symbol BRLS
The current market price is $9.20
The current price appreciation (book value): 2588%
The current market value of the respondent’s shares: $443,500
Lock-up period: one year 
 
Warrants and Options granted to directors and founders have not been disclosed.
 

 
The Final Hearing before Justice MacDonald started on Monday 19th February. During his testimonies under oath the respondent represented that his shares in Oxus Acquisition Fund were worth zero. He also instructed his counsel to represent to the Court that his “shares in Oxus were on the side and were worth zero”. This is a false representation. The shares owned by the respondent are worth $443,500. The lock-up period does not define the value of the shares. The respondent can borrow against the shares during the lock-up and can monetize them. He knows this. The key metric which determines the value of the shares is the CLOSING OF THE MERGER TRANSACTION. This happened on 7 February 2024, 11 days before the trial started. 
THAT IS THE DATE WHICH DETERMINES THE VALUE OF THE RESPONDENT’S SHARES.

 

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

OXUS: GRANT DATE (CONDITIONAL) VS TRIGGER DATE VS VESTING DATE

 

I am presenting the key points supporting my position that the respondent lied under oath and made flagrant false representation, that the respondent knew and should have known that his 50,000 shares were NOT worth zero at the time of the Final Trial, and that he intentionally made representations he knew to be false and took the Court and me for fools in order to keep the windfall for himself.

 

I am adding the vesting schedule so you can understand the full picture.

 

Further to my email of 29 February 2024 setting out the timeline of the closing of the transaction and the consummation of the acquisition by Oxus of Borealis (the Target), the business combination closed on 7th February 2024 and, on 8th February 2024, Newco began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol BRLS.

 

As per the attached SEC filings and as discussed at our meeting on 29 February 2024, here is a recap of the events:

 
The respondent was granted 50,000 Founders’ shares on 7 June 2022 (page 341 of attached SEC Prospectus)
The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination).
The Business Combination occurred on 7th February 2024.
Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8th February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.
The Founder Shares lock-up period is defined below and in page 5 of the Prospectus filed with the SEC (attached).
 

 

FALSE REPRESENTATIONS TO HIS LORDSHIP UNDER OATH: THERE ARE THREE DATES WHICH FAMILY COURT MUST UNDERSTAND: (I) GRANT DATE, (II) EFFECTIVE DATE, AND (III) VESTING DATE. 

 
STEP 1: GRANT DATE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT OWNERSHIP OF 50,000 CONDITIONAL TO BUSINESS COMBINATION.
STEP 2: EFFECTIVE DATE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT UNCONDITIONAL OWNERSHIP OF 50,000 SHARES UPON CLOSING OF THE BUSINESS COMBINATION.
STEP 3: VESTING SCHEDULE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT THE RIGHT TO SELL HIS SHARES ACCORDING TO A TWO-TIER SCHEDULE.
 

THE RESPONDENT HAS MADE AN INTENTIONAL WORLD SALAD OF THE ABOVE AND IS ONCE AGAIN LEVERAGING HIS ASYMETRICAL KNOWLEDGE OF FINANCE IN ORDER TO CREATE CONFUSION BETWEEN THE THREE DATES (I) THE GRANT DATE (7 JUNE 2022), (II) THE EFFECTIVE DATE (COMPLETION OF BUSINESS COMBINATION 7TH FEBRUARY 2024) AND (III) VESTING DATE (50% FORMULA AND 50% 12 MONTHS AFTER BUSINESS COMBINATION).

 

TESTIMONY UNDER OATH AT THE FINAL TRIAL

 

ON 19TH FEBRUARY 2024, THE FINAL TRIAL “ZAHMOUL VS ZAHMOUL” BEGAN IN THE RCJ, HIGH COURT FAMILY DIVISION, BEFORE HIS LORDSHIP JUSTICE MACDONALD.

 

THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT MADE DURING THE TRIAL UNDER OATH:  “THE FOUNDERS’ SHARES HELD BY THE RESPONDENT ARE WORTH ZERO” IS A FALSE STATEMENT AND LIE MADE TO THE COURT UNDER OATH.

 

THE RESPONDENT FALSELY REPRESENTED TO THE COURT UNDER OATH THAT HIS 50,000 SHARES WERE WORTH “ZERO” AND THAT HE WOULD NOT KNOW THEIR VALUE UNTIL ONE YEAR HAS PASSED. THIS IS AN INTENTIOANL MISREPRESENTATION AND IT IS A FALSE STATEMENT. THE VALUE OF THE RESPONDENT’S HOLDINGS CAN NOW BE TRACKED DAILY ON A MARKED-TO-MARKET BASIS USING BRLS PRICE PERFORMANCE. THE RESPONDENT CAN MONETIZE THIS POSITION, BORROW AGAINST IT, pleadge it, use it as collateral, USE IT IN HIS ASSET SCHEDULE WHEN APPLYING TO MORTGAGE INSTITUTIONS, ETC. IT IS PART OF HIS ASSETS AND IT HAS A VALUE OF APPROXIMATELY $0.5 MILLION. VESTING PERIOD HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH OWNERSHIP OF THE ASSET. THE ASSET HAS A VALUE AND THE ASSET CAN NOW BE INCLUDED IN THE RESPONDENT’S PERSONAL BALANCE SHEET.

 

MORE IMPORTANTLY, AS OF 7 FEBRUARY 2024, THE RESPONDENT HAD A DUTY TO UPDATE HIS FORM E AND REPORT HIS 50,000 FOUNDERS SHARES IN OXUS AT THE VALUE OF $0.5 MILLION.

 

AT THE TIME HE MADE THIS STATEMENT AND HE INSTRUCTED HIS COUNSEL TO SAY THE SAME, THIS WAS A FALSE REPRESENTATION AND THE RESPONDENT KNEW IT TO BE A FALSE REPRESENTATION.

 

THERE IS NO STRESS, NO INNUENDOS, NO EXCUSES, NO KITE SURFING: THIS IS A PREMEDITATED, CALCULATED, AND INTENTIONAL FALSE REPRESENTATION WITH THE INTENT TO MAKE A FINANCIAL GAIN AT MY EXPENSE. 

 

THE RESPONDENT IS TAKING THE COURT AND ME FOR FOOLS.

GENERAL – PROCESS GOING FORWARD:

 

This is my second email regarding Oxus and the respondent’s false representations to the court during the Final Trial.

This is my third email requesting clarity on the process going forward.

 

Zoe emailed today: “As Brent advised on Thursday, we should first ascertain Karim’s position in relation to Oxus before considering any next steps”. 

This is not a satisfactory answer because time is not neutral. The passage of time is positive for the respondent and negative for me. I need something better, more precise, and I need an explanation.

 

Basic game theory states that the respondent’s best alternative is to not answer our request and to delay as much as possible. This is what he has done with every single issue that what NOT in his best interest, including: Imerman, NY appraisals, Coinbase, Forte Securities. This is what he is doing now.

 

Basic game theory states that the sooner I send this to the judge, the more impact it will have on his judgement.

 

I am not willing to wait indefinitely for the respondent to provide an answer which we all know he will need a gun to his head to produce as it is hugely negative to his case.

 

In the absence of any guidelines from you and Zoe regarding how long you are asking me to wait for an answer which I know will not be forthcoming, and in the absence of any communications from you and Zoe since 29 February 2024,  I am utterly without guidance and advice at a stage which is critical for the rest of my life and my daughters’ financial future. 

 

Thus, unless you and Zoe communicate with me and explain what the process is from now to the end, and what the deadline for the respondent to respondent to Oxus and what are the supporting arguments behind your proposed deadline, I have decided to send the Oxus matter to His Lordship tomorrow by noon because I have no way of knowing what is best for me given the absence of communication from counsel and from my solicitor. 

 
I have been extremely clear that I will not take any chances with the process from now until the time the money is in the bank.
I have explained that I would like COMPLETE CLARITY AS TO WHAT LEVEL OF SUPPORT AND ADVICE AND GUIDANCE I CAN EXPECT FROM YOU. 
I HAVE EXPLAINED THAT I AM NOT IN A RISK-TAKING MODE AND I WANT AN ERROR-FREE EXECUTION PROCESS FROM NOW UNTIL THE TIME THE MONEY IS IN THE BANK, AND MUST BE EXTREMELY VIGILENT WITH THE COURT ORDERS.
I HAVE EXPLAINED THAT I COMPLETELY UNDERSTAND IF YOU AND ZOE ARE NOT FUNDED TO PROVIDE THE LEVEL OF HAND HOLDING, I AM REQUESTING BUT I WOULE LIKE YOU TO TELL ME NOW. NOT TOMORROW. BUT NOW.
THEN, I WILL BE FREE TO EXPLORE OPTIONS THAT WORK FOR ME.  THE PROCESS AHEAD OF US HAS HUGE EXECUTION RISKS AND I NEED HAND HOLDING, COMMUNICATION, EXPERT ADVICE, AND EXTREME VIGILENCE. 
IF YOU CANNOT PROVIDE WHAT I NEED, YOU MUST TELL ME KNOW SO I CAN DO WHAT IS BEST FOR ME AND MY DAUGHTERS.
I CANNOT STAY IN THE DARK ABOUT THE FORTHCOMING PROCESS. THIS IS NOT AN OPTION. EVERY DAY AND EVERY MINUTE COUNTS. I NEED OPEN CHANNELS OF COMMUNICATION; I NEED TO UNDERSTAND THE PROCESS. 
I NEED TO HAVE EXTREMELY CLEAR AND REALISTIC EXPECTATIONS. PLEASE SET OUT WHAT SCAFFOLDING (IN ANY) YOU CAN PROVIDE ME UNTIL THE END OF THE PROCESS.
IF IT IS NOT SUFFICIENT FOR ME, THEN IT IS MY JOB TO FIND A SET UP THAT WORKS FOR ME.
FOR NOW, YOU ARE HOLDING ME BACK BECAUSE YOU SAID YOU ARE NOT IN FUNDS AND NOW YOU ARE NOT TELLING ME WHAT THAT MEANS IN TERMS OF MY CASE.
I SAID VERY CLEARLY WHAT MY NEEDS AND EXPECTATIONS ARE.
I UNDERSTAND YOU ARE NOT IN FUNDS AND I RESPECT YOU RUN A BUSINESS, NOT A CHARITABLE ORGANISATION.
PLEASE EXPLAIN TO ME VERY CLEARLY WHAT YOU CAN DELIVER (IF ANY) AND WHAT YOU CANNOT.
STAYING IN THE DARK IS NOT AN OPTION. I NEED TO DECIDE AND MOVE FORWARD. MY LIFE AND MY CHILDREN’S FREEDOM DEPENDS ON WHAT I DO IN THE NEXT FEW WEEKS.
I CANNOT AFFORD ANY UNCERTAINTY AND I NEED EXACTLY WHAT I SPELT OUT ABOVE: HAND-HOLDING AT EVERY STEP, EXTREME VIGILENCE WITH THE COURT ORDERS, SEEMLESS COMMUNICATION BETWEEN ME, YOU AND BRENT, UNTIL THE MONEY IS IN THE BANK AND MY FUTURE LITIGATIONS AGAINST THE RESPONDENDENT ARE SECURE AND UNOPPOSED BY THIS COURT.
IF THIS IS NOT POSSIBLE, TELL ME IMMEDIATELY, IN WRITING, SO I AM FREE TO CONSIDER THE OPTIONS THAT SUIT MY NEEDS AS DEFINED BY ME.
 

OXUS: GRANT DATE (CONDITIONAL) VS TRIGGER DATE VS VESTING DATE

 

I am presenting the key points supporting my position that the respondent lied under oath and made flagrant false representation, that the respondent knew and should have known that his 50,000 shares were NOT worth zero at the time of the Final Trial, and that he intentionally made representations he knew to be false and took the Court and me for fools in order to keep the windfall for himself.

 

I am adding the vesting schedule so you can understand the full picture.

 

Further to my email of 29 February 2024 setting out the timeline of the closing of the transaction and the consummation of the acquisition by Oxus of Borealis (the Target), the business combination closed on 7th February 2024 and, on 8th February 2024, Newco began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol BRLS.

 

As per the attached SEC filings and as discussed at our meeting on 29 February 2024, here is a recap of the events:

 
The respondent was granted 50,000 Founders’ shares on 7 June 2022 (page 341 of attached SEC Prospectus)
The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination).
The Business Combination occurred on 7th February 2024.
Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8th February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.
The Founder Shares lock-up period is defined below and in page 5 of the Prospectus filed with the SEC (attached).
 

 

FALSE REPRESENTATIONS TO HIS LORDSHIP UNDER OATH: THERE ARE THREE DATES WHICH FAMILY COURT MUST UNDERSTAND: (I) GRANT DATE, (II) EFFECTIVE DATE, AND (III) VESTING DATE. 

 
STEP 1: GRANT DATE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT OWNERSHIP OF 50,000 CONDITIONAL TO BUSINESS COMBINATION.
STEP 2: EFFECTIVE DATE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT UNCONDITIONAL OWNERSHIP OF 50,000 SHARES UPON CLOSING OF THE BUSINESS COMBINATION.
STEP 3: VESTING SCHEDULE: GIVES THE RESPONDENT THE RIGHT TO SELL HIS SHARES ACCORDING TO A TWO-TIER SCHEDULE.
 

THE RESPONDENT HAS MADE AN INTENTIONAL WORLD SALAD OF THE ABOVE AND IS ONCE AGAIN LEVERAGING HIS ASYMETRICAL KNOWLEDGE OF FINANCE IN ORDER TO CREATE CONFUSION BETWEEN THE THREE DATES (I) THE GRANT DATE (7 JUNE 2022), (II) THE EFFECTIVE DATE (COMPLETION OF BUSINESS COMBINATION 7TH FEBRUARY 2024) AND (III) VESTING DATE (50% FORMULA AND 50% 12 MONTHS AFTER BUSINESS COMBINATION).

 

TESTIMONY UNDER OATH AT THE FINAL TRIAL

 

ON 19TH FEBRUARY 2024, THE FINAL TRIAL “ZAHMOUL VS ZAHMOUL” BEGAN IN THE RCJ, HIGH COURT FAMILY DIVISION, BEFORE HIS LORDSHIP JUSTICE MACDONALD.

 

THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT MADE DURING THE TRIAL UNDER OATH:  “THE FOUNDERS’ SHARES HELD BY THE RESPONDENT ARE WORTH ZERO” IS A FALSE STATEMENT AND LIE MADE TO THE COURT UNDER OATH.

 

THE RESPONDENT FALSELY REPRESENTED TO THE COURT UNDER OATH THAT HIS 50,000 SHARES WERE WORTH “ZERO” AND THAT HE WOULD NOT KNOW THEIR VALUE UNTIL ONE YEAR HAS PASSED. THIS IS AN INTENTIOANL MISREPRESENTATION AND IT IS A FALSE STATEMENT. THE VALUE OF THE RESPONDENT’S HOLDINGS CAN NOW BE TRACKED DAILY ON A MARKED-TO-MARKET BASIS USING BRLS PRICE PERFORMANCE. THE RESPONDENT CAN MONETIZE THIS POSITION, BORROW AGAINST IT, pleadge it, use it as collateral, USE IT IN HIS ASSET SCHEDULE WHEN APPLYING TO MORTGAGE INSTITUTIONS, ETC. IT IS PART OF HIS ASSETS AND IT HAS A VALUE OF APPROXIMATELY $0.5 MILLION. VESTING PERIOD HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH OWNERSHIP OF THE ASSET. THE ASSET HAS A VALUE AND THE ASSET CAN NOW BE INCLUDED IN THE RESPONDENT’S PERSONAL BALANCE SHEET.

 

MORE IMPORTANTLY, AS OF 7 FEBRUARY 2024, THE RESPONDENT HAD A DUTY TO UPDATE HIS FORM E AND REPORT HIS 50,000 FOUNDERS SHARES IN OXUS AT THE VALUE OF $0.5 MILLION.

 

AT THE TIME HE MADE THIS STATEMENT AND HE INSTRUCTED HIS COUNSEL TO SAY THE SAME, THIS WAS A FALSE REPRESENTATION AND THE RESPONDENT KNEW IT TO BE A FALSE REPRESENTATION.

 

THERE IS NO STRESS, NO INNUENDOS, NO EXCUSES, NO KITE SURFING: THIS IS A PREMEDITATED, CALCULATED, AND INTENTIONAL FALSE REPRESENTATION WITH THE INTENT TO MAKE A FINANCIAL GAIN AT MY EXPENSE. 

 

THE RESPONDENT IS TAKING THE COURT AND ME FOR FOOLS.

Dear Anita,

 

I hope you are well.

I would be most grateful if you could please pass this on to His Lordship. 

This is material to the case and to the Final Hearing which took place before His Lordship on 19th - 28th February 2024. 

I am copying counsels on both sides.

Your Lordship,

 

I am sincerely sorry to trouble Your Lordship so soon after the Final Hearing. The matter of Oxus Acquisition Corp. is very material to the case and came to my attention almost immediately after the trial ended.  Despite writing to the respondent one week ago to request an explanation, we have not received a reply. 

 

This open-ended situation is very harmful to me. I feel powerless, vulnerable, and extremely distressed. I find it impossible to put the children’s and my future into the respondent’s hands and wait without knowing how long I must wait.

 

I put the matter into Your Lordship’s hands and if one week is not enough, I am happy to wait as long as Your Lordship would like me to. 

 

At the Final Hearing and under oath, the respondent represented that his shares in Oxus Acquisition Corp. were “worth zero”. In the asset schedule submitted for the Final Hearing, he reported 50,000 shares at a value of $0.00. 

 

This is factually incorrect and constitutes a false statement.

 
The respondent was appointed to the Board of Directors of Oxus Acquisition Corp. on 1st June 2022 and 
On 7th June 2022 Form 3 “Initial Statement of Beneficial Ownership of Securities” was filed with the SEC.
PAGE 340 of SEC PROSPECTUS (attached): “On June 7, 2022, 50,000 Founder Shares were transferred to Mr. Karim Zahmoul by the Sponsor. The fair value of the 50,000 Founder Shares granted to the Mr. Karim Zahmoul on June 7, 2022, was $0.02 million or $0.33 per share. The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination)”.
The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination).
The Business Combination occurred on 7th February 2024.
Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8th February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.
The Founder Shares lock-up period is defined in page 43 of the Prospectus filed with the SEC (attached) and in the attached SEC Filings Excerpts.
 

Conclusion: 

The Final Hearing started on 19th February 2024. 

At the time of the Final Hearing and when he testified under oath, the respondent knew (i) that the Business Combination had occurred and (ii) that the value of his 50,000 Founders Shares was not zero.

 

Email sent to the respondent’s solicitors on 29th February 2024 (attached):

“Dear Valeria,

We attach documents in relation to the SPAC merger between Oxus and Borealis which closed on 7th February 2024. The post-merger stock has been trading on the NASDAQ since the 8th February 2024. In his ES2 dated 19.02.2024 he ascribes a nil value to his OXUS equity. Given that the merged entity (ticker BRLS) is trading at a stock price of $9.20 (and your client had 50,000 shares in the pre-merger OXUS) please can you explain the value of his stockholding with reference to the attached documents and any others in your clients possession – and why he ascribed a nil value to his equity in the ES2. 

We look forward to hearing from you.”

 

Respectfully,

 

Nadia Zahmoul

records.summary: On 6 March 2024 at 16:28, Zoe Bloom sent the pivotal email that frames the entire March 2024 judgment representation crisis. Zoe stated she had received approximately 8 emails from W which were "very dense" and she had not been able to assimilate. Zoe confirmed she had asked Faye to send W a Notice of Acting in Person so W could engage directly with the court and H's team. Zoe then stated the final bill was being prepared at £40,000 plus disbursements against £31,087 on account — leaving an £8,913+ shortfall — and that there were therefore no funds for ongoing work. Then, critically: "Brent and I will obviously comply with our obligations to the court in relation to judgment." This sentence — Statement 1 in W's 19 March email — is the foundation of the draft order claim. It represents an unequivocal commitment that Brent and Zoe would attend judgment. On 18 March 2024, Faye contradicted it entirely: "We are currently off the record and don't have instructions to come back on the record for the purposes of receipt of judgment and drafting the order." The contradiction between these two statements is the core of W's judgment representation grievance.

Dear Anita,

 

I hope you are well.

This is material to the case and to the Final Hearing which took place before His Lordship on 19th - 28th February 2024. 

I am copying counsels on both sides.

Your Lordship,

 

I am sincerely sorry to trouble Your Lordship so soon after the Final Hearing. The matter of Oxus Acquisition Corp. is very material to the case and came to my attention almost immediately after the trial ended.  Despite writing to the respondent one week ago to request an explanation, we have not received a reply. 

 

This open-ended situation is very harmful to me. I feel powerless, vulnerable, and extremely distressed. I find it impossible to put the children’s and my future into the respondent’s hands and wait without knowing how long I must wait.

 

I put the matter into Your Lordship’s hands and if one week is not enough, I am happy to wait as long as Your Lordship would like me to. 

 

At the Final Hearing and under oath, the respondent represented that his shares in Oxus Acquisition Corp. were “worth zero”. In the asset schedule submitted for the Final Hearing, he reported 50,000 shares at a value of $0.00. 

 

This is factually incorrect and constitutes a false statement.

 
The respondent was appointed to the Board of Directors of Oxus Acquisition Corp. on 1st June 2022 and 
On 7th June 2022 Form 3 “Initial Statement of Beneficial Ownership of Securities” was filed with the SEC.
PAGE 340 of SEC PROSPECTUS (attached): “On June 7, 2022, 50,000 Founder Shares were transferred to Mr. Karim Zahmoul by the Sponsor. The fair value of the 50,000 Founder Shares granted to the Mr. Karim Zahmoul on June 7, 2022, was $0.02 million or $0.33 per share. The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination)”.
The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination).
The Business Combination occurred on 7th February 2024.
Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8th February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.
The Founder Shares lock-up period is defined in page 43 of the Prospectus filed with the SEC (attached) and in the attached SEC Filings Excerpts.
 

Conclusion: 

The Final Hearing started on 19th February 2024. 

At the time of the Final Hearing and when he testified under oath, the respondent knew (i) that the Business Combination had occurred and (ii) that the value of his 50,000 Founders Shares was not zero.

 

Email sent to the respondent’s solicitors on 29th February 2024 (attached):

“Dear Valeria,

We attach documents in relation to the SPAC merger between Oxus and Borealis which closed on 7th February 2024. The post-merger stock has been trading on the NASDAQ since the 8th February 2024. In his ES2 dated 19.02.2024 he ascribes a nil value to his OXUS equity. Given that the merged entity (ticker BRLS) is trading at a stock price of $9.20 (and your client had 50,000 shares in the pre-merger OXUS) please can you explain the value of his stockholding with reference to the attached documents and any others in your clients possession – and why he ascribed a nil value to his equity in the ES2. 

We look forward to hearing from you.”

 

Respectfully,

 

Nadia Zahmoul

The Founder Shares were granted subject to a performance condition (i.e., the occurrence of a Business Combination).
The Business Combination occurred on 7th February 2024.
Newco began trading on Nasdaq on 8th February 2024 under the ticker symbol BRLS.
The Founder Shares lock-up period is defined in page 43 of the Prospectus filed with the SEC (attached) and in the attached SEC Filings Excerpts.
 

Conclusion: 

The Final Hearing started on 19th February 2024. 

At the time of the Final Hearing and when he testified under oath, the respondent knew (i) that the Business Combination had occurred and (ii) that the value of his 50,000 Founders Shares was not zero.

 

Email sent to the respondent’s solicitors on 29th February 2024 (attached):

“Dear Valeria,

We attach documents in relation to the SPAC merger between Oxus and Borealis which closed on 7th February 2024. The post-merger stock has been trading on the NASDAQ since the 8th February 2024. In his ES2 dated 19.02.2024 he ascribes a nil value to his OXUS equity. Given that the merged entity (ticker BRLS) is trading at a stock price of $9.20 (and your client had 50,000 shares in the pre-merger OXUS) please can you explain the value of his stockholding with reference to the attached documents and any others in your clients possession – and why he ascribed a nil value to his equity in the ES2. 

We look forward to hearing from you.”

 

Respectfully,

 

Nadia Zahmoul

records.subject: Urgent - BV20D01752 - FALSE REPRESENTATIONS MADE DURING TRIAL
records.body:
Dear Anita,

 

I hope you are well.

As you probably know, I am acting in person as I no longer have the funds to pay for my legal costs. I attach the email sent yesterday with the notice of acting in person.

I would be most grateful if you could please pass this on to His Lordship as this is an urgent matter which is material to the case.

 

With my kind wishes,

Nadia

===================================================================================================================

 

Your Lordship,

 

This is not an application to reopen the evidence. 

 

I am not introducing any new evidence. I am also acting in person as no amount of money can be enough to pay for the extraordinary amount of work necessitated to untangle the respondent’s transactions, disclosures, statements and etc.

 

I would like to draw the Court’s attention to the false representations the respondent made under oath with regards to Oxus Acquisition Corp. during the Final Hearing.

 

The trial started on 19th February 2024. On that day, the respondent knew that the Business Combination had been consummated on 7th February 2024. The Business Combination date is crucial as it is the trigger for the respondent’s 50,000 shares to become valuable. 

 

The value of his Oxus shares is binary: it is zero if there is no Business Combination and it is marked-to-market starting on the exact day the Business Combination is effective, which was 7th February 2024, 10 days before the trial started.

 

Therefore, the respondent should have assigned a value of approximately $500,000 to the Oxus shares on ES2 starting on the 7th February 2024 and he should not have instructed his counsel to state that the “Oxus shares are worth nothing”. In fact, he should have replaced Oxus shares with BRLS shares and he should have disclosed the number of BRLS shares he now owns given the exchange rate and the redemptions. Furthermore, the respondent has never told the Court how many warrants he received.

 

When he appeared before Your Lordship on 19th February 2024, the respondent knew that the Business Combination had been consummated on 7th February 2024 and he knew that on 8th February 2024, the newly merged company began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol BRLS. Oxus was retired from Nasdaq on that day.

 

He assigned a value of zero to the shares on his ES2 schedule dated 19th February 2024. This is an intentional false representation. It is absolutely false and dishonest.

 

He told the Court that his Oxus shares were “worth nothing”. This is a false representation, and this is dishonest.

 

In summary, during the Final Hearing before Your Lordship, the respondent intentionally misled the Court and me, he made false representations to the Court under oath, he mismarked his ES2 schedule, and he instructed his counsel to make factually incorrect statements in her submissions. 

 

I attach a comprehensive review of what the respondent did, what he knew, when he knew it, and what he told the Court.

 

As a director of Oxus, the respondent signed the SEC filings of January and February 2024, so he cannot say that he was “overwhelmed” and “stressed”. 

 

My previous solicitors emailed the respondent’s solicitors on 29th February 2024 requesting an explanation. I have not received a reply.

 

Your Lordship, I would like to say one more time that there is no new evidence in the attached statement. My only objective is to bring this to your attention as it is very material to my case. The statement is simply a reconstruction of the respondent’s tortuous and deceitful acts and how they fail to stand up to scrutiny.

 

Respectfully,

 

Nadia Zahmoul

Dear Zoe,

 

I am following up on the email exchange of yesterday.

 

As you are aware, I have been unwell for quite some time due to the abuse in the marriage and the respondent’s conduct during the proceedings.

 

The trial pushed my PTSD symptoms into unprecedented territories. At present I am suffering from a rapid heartbeat condition, gastric pain, and my left hand is numb. My nervous system has been utterly destroyed. I am starting EMDR sessions next week and I will attend an inpatient trauma programme as soon as I have my financial independence..

 

I am incapable of representing myself for the judgement and for drafting the orders under the current conditions.

 

Also, I am unable to speak with or communicate with the respondent for the rest of my life.

 

In emails dated 6 and 18 March, 2024 you made two following two statements: 

 

Statement 1 (email of 6 March 2024): “BRENT AND I WILL OBVIOUSLY COMPLY WITH OUR OBLIGATIONS TO THE COURT IN RELATION TO THE JUDGEMENT”.

 

Statement 2 (email of 18 March 2024): “We are currently off the record and don’t have instructions to come back on the record for the purposes of receipt of judgment and drafting the order. In the event that you find yourself in funds so that you can give us that instruction, we can discuss it then. “

 

Statements 1 and 2 are not consistent and I find this extremely confusing and distressing. 

 
Which one of these two statements is true, and which one is false? 
Is Brent representing me at the judgement?
Is Brent representing me for the drafting of the orders?
Are you representing me for the judgement?
Are you representing me for the drafting of the orders?
If any of the above answers is “No”, please could you send me an estimate of the fees required to represent me.
 

 

I need the above information as a matter of urgency in order to include in the LSPO application. 

 

I cannot represent myself for the judgment and the orders, and I have no funds. Therefore, the court must order the respondent to pay for my legal fees.

 

I will send the LSPO tomorrow if I don’t hear from you.

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

From: Nadia <nadia@rosekross.com> 
Sent: Tuesday, March 19, 2024 7:04 PM
To: Zoë Bloom <Zoe.Bloom@afpbloom.com>
Cc: Faye Simpson <faye.simpson@afpbloom.com>
Subject: FW: Private and Confidential: financial proceedings
Importance: High

 

Dear Zoe,

 

I am following up on the email exchange of yesterday.

 

As you are aware, I have been unwell for quite some time due to the abuse in the marriage and the respondent’s conduct during the proceedings.

 

The trial pushed my PTSD symptoms into unprecedented territories. At present I am suffering from a rapid heartbeat condition, gastric pain, and my left hand is numb. My nervous system has been utterly destroyed. I am starting EMDR sessions next week and I will attend an inpatient trauma programme as soon as I have my financial independence..

 

I am incapable of representing myself for the judgement and for drafting the orders under the current conditions.

 

Also, I am unable to speak with or communicate with the respondent for the rest of my life.

 

In emails dated 6 and 18 March, 2024 you made two following two statements: 

 

Statement 1 (email of 6 March 2024): “BRENT AND I WILL OBVIOUSLY COMPLY WITH OUR OBLIGATIONS TO THE COURT IN RELATION TO THE JUDGEMENT”.

 

Statement 2 (email of 18 March 2024): “We are currently off the record and don’t have instructions to come back on the record for the purposes of receipt of judgment and drafting the order. In the event that you find yourself in funds so that you can give us that instruction, we can discuss it then. “

 

Statements 1 and 2 are not consistent and I find this extremely confusing and distressing. 

 
Which one of these two statements is true, and which one is false? 
Is Brent representing me at the judgement?
Is Brent representing me for the drafting of the orders?
Are you representing me for the judgement?
Are you representing me for the drafting of the orders?
If any of the above answers is “No”, please could you send me an estimate of the fees required to represent me.
 

 

I need the above information as a matter of urgency in order to include in the LSPO application. 

 

I cannot represent myself for the judgment and the orders, and I have no funds. Therefore, the court must order the respondent to pay for my legal fees.

 

I will send the LSPO tomorrow if I don’t hear from you.

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia

Dear Nadia
I am sorry you remain so unwell.
The current position is that my firm is owed around  12,000. I remind you that under the terms of the letter of instruction dated 24 January 2024 (attached), you agreed to liquidate your 401K and pay USD30,000 to my firm s client account and provide a bank guarantee. You did not comply with those terms. If you had complied with the terms, I would have sufficient money both to discharge the outstanding fees and continue to act until the liquid sums had been used.
If we are reinstructed, then the fees will depend on what we are instructed to do. If it is simply to appear in court for the judgment then Brent will charge a refresher which I anticipate will be  8,000. My fees will be incurred on an hourly basis. Brent will then proceed to draft the court s order but that will be a simple process of translating the judgment of the court into the court s order.  It will not be a case of trying to renegotiate or relitigate what the Judge has decided.
If I am reinstructed, and you ask me to instruct Brent then he will not charge you for carriage of the order (i.e. drafting it in liaison with the other side). That would be included within the brief fee. Obviously, if he has to go to court then he will charge for that (alongside any other consultations that you require). The difficulty for him, I envisage, is that because he does not act on a direct access basis, he would need to be instructed by me which would require you to instruct me. He could not just otherwise draft the order because he would be without instructions from you. I say this because I want to make clear that neither he nor I are attempting to charge you for something (i.e. the drafting of the order) which would otherwise have formed part of the brief fee on the basis of the original instruction. I hope this is clear.
To reiterate, the fees which would be incurred to attend a hearing where judgment is handed down to be in the region of  5,000 for me and  8,000 for Brent. There will also be my fees incurred on an hourly rate for any work I do with Brent and you on the order. This may be 6 hours work at around  3k. The total cost will be  16,000 on the basis that there is a hearing for the judgment. Less if there is not but at present we do not know how judgment will be handed down.
If the judgment is handed down in writing, and there is no hearing then any time will be incurred which does not relate to the simple drafting of the court s order will be charged on an hourly basis by Brent and I.
In any event, in order to resume my firm s instruction the outstanding fees (c. 12k) will need to be discharged and I will require a payment on account of  16,000.
If you have any questions, please let me know.
Very best
Bloom

Dear Nadia
I am sorry you remain so unwell.
The current position is that my firm is owed around  12,000. I remind you that under the terms of the letter of instruction dated 24 January 2024 (attached), you agreed to liquidate your 401K and pay USD30,000 to my firm s client account and provide a bank guarantee. You did not comply with those terms. If you had complied with the terms, I would have sufficient money both to discharge the outstanding fees and continue to act until the liquid sums had been used.
If we are reinstructed, then the fees will depend on what we are instructed to do. If it is simply to appear in court for the judgment then Brent will charge a refresher which I anticipate will be  8,000. My fees will be incurred on an hourly basis. Brent will then proceed to draft the court s order but that will be a simple process of translating the judgment of the court into the court s order.  It will not be a case of trying to renegotiate or relitigate what the Judge has decided.
If I am reinstructed, and you ask me to instruct Brent then he will not charge you for carriage of the order (i.e. drafting it in liaison with the other side). That would be included within the brief fee. Obviously, if he has to go to court then he will charge for that (alongside any other consultations that you require). The difficulty for him, I envisage, is that because he does not act on a direct access basis, he would need to be instructed by me which would require you to instruct me. He could not just otherwise draft the order because he would be without instructions from you. I say this because I want to make clear that neither he nor I are attempting to charge you for something (i.e. the drafting of the order) which would otherwise have formed part of the brief fee on the basis of the original instruction. I hope this is clear.
To reiterate, the fees which would be incurred to attend a hearing where judgment is handed down to be in the region of  5,000 for me and  8,000 for Brent. There will also be my fees incurred on an hourly rate for any work I do with Brent and you on the order. This may be 6 hours work at around  3k. The total cost will be  16,000 on the basis that there is a hearing for the judgment. Less if there is not but at present we do not know how judgment will be handed down.
If the judgment is handed down in writing, and there is no hearing then any time will be incurred which does not relate to the simple drafting of the court s order will be charged on an hourly basis by Brent and I.
In any event, in order to resume my firm s instruction the outstanding fees (c. 12k) will need to be discharged and I will require a payment on account of  16,000.
If you have any questions, please let me know.
Very best
Bloom

records.body:
Dear Zoe,

 

Thank you for your email.

 

I will write to the judge to explain that I cannot be represented at the judgement and for the drafting of the orders unless I have funding of a minimum of £28,000. This is only for basic services (attendance, drafting and nothing else). If the court does not address the funding matter, I will be put at a huge disadvantage relative to the respondent. This would be hugely unfair and unequitable. 

 

Before I email the judge, I would like to make sure that my understanding of your emails is correct. Therefore, could you please confirm that the attached summary and the statements below are correct.

 

If I don’t hear from you by end of day today, I will email the judge on the basis of my understanding in this email.

 

Please could you confirm that the statements below are all true:

 
The original Brief Fee includes drafting of the order but not court attendance.
BMKC does not accept direct access instructions.
BMKC must be instructed by ZB in order to attend court and draft the orders.
Therefore, ZB must be instructed regardless of whether the judgement is made in writing or whether there is a court hearing.  
 
If there is a hearing and court attendance is required.
Attendance BMKC: £8,000

Attendance ZB: £5,000

ZB work on orders: £3,000.

Sub-total: £16,000

Plus: outstanding balance £12,000

Total estimate: £28,000

 
If the judgement is handed down in writing:
Outstanding balance: £12,000

Payment on account: £16,000

Total estimate: £28,000

 

With kind wishes,

Nadia
